items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: Tadd Dameron was one of those type of arrangers. The arrangements that Tadd Dameron did, you could see that he was going to be famous, too.

ctx.x: Who else was in Kansas City at that time.

Well -- Tadd Dameron. Tadd Dameron who used to arrange for Harlan Leonard and played a lot of his beautiful arrangements. And Jay McShann and the musicians with the famous Charlie Parker, and it was beautiful to know him, to play with him.
